reply: I have checked your account, but the system that holds your current entitlement information is experiencing a temporary error, so I cannot confirm your seat count or exact entitlements right now. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist. For reference, seat additions are billed pro rata from the day they are added and seat removals take effect at the next renewal (see kb-0011). If you'd like us to investigate the specific invoice discrepancy, please attach the invoice ID and the amount you expected to your reply when the specialist reaches out.
